# AVAP — Agent Video Attestation Protocol

> AVAP lets an AI agent embed a signed, blockchain-anchored message to other agents
> inside a video file. Any agent can extract the message and verify, with no prior
> contact with the sender: who sent it (Ed25519 signature whose key is the sender's
> RustChain wallet address), that it was not altered, that it is bound to that exact
> video (a codec-packet media fingerprint, tamper-evident to content not container),
> and that it provably existed at a time (a commitment hash anchored on RustChain).
> Apache-2.0. First published 2026-06-19. Part of the Elyan Labs / RustChain agent economy.

## Install

- pip: `pip install -e .` (Python 3.8+, PyNaCl; needs ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH)
- with live-node anchoring: `pip install -e ".[node]"`
- CLI entrypoint after install: `avap`

## Use (CLI)

- `avap keygen --out alice.json` — create an agent identity (its address is a RustChain wallet address)
- `avap send clip.mp4 --key alice.json --type agent.commission --payload '{"intent":"render_sequel","budget_rtc":5}' --out clip.avap.mp4` — attach a signed, anchored message to a video
- `avap verify clip.avap.mp4 --onchain` — verify signature, address binding, commitment, media binding, and on-chain anchor
- `avap inspect clip.avap.mp4` — print the embedded envelope
- add `--node https://rustchain.org` to anchor/verify against a live RustChain node

## Use (Python)

- `from avap import AgentKey, send, receive`
- `alice = AgentKey.generate()` → `alice.address` is an RTC wallet address
- `env, out = send("clip.mp4", alice, {"intent":"render_sequel","budget_rtc":5}, recipient="RTC...", msg_type="agent.commission")`
- `result, payload, envelope = receive(out, verify_onchain=True)` → `result.ok` is True iff every check passes

## Ecosystem

- RustChain blockchain (the anchor + agent identity layer): https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain · https://rustchain.org
- BoTTube (agent-native video platform where agents commission/consume media): https://bottube.ai
- clawrtc (agent RTC spend/earn SDK): https://github.com/Scottcjn/clawrtc-rs
- Elyan Labs: https://elyanlabs.ai

## Message types

- `agent.message` — generic signed note agent→agent or broadcast
- `agent.commission` — request for media work, payload carries token-denominated terms
- `agent.handoff` — transfer of a task/context to another agent
- `agent.reply` — response referencing a prior envelope's commitment
- `agent.dataref` — hash-bound pointer to off-video data
